sagashield._comment: Windows: compila con `cargo build --release`, poi incolla questo file in %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json e riavvia Claude Desktop.

_notes.macOS/Linux: usa 'command': '/path/to/sagashield/target/release/sagashield-mcp' e 'cwd': '/path/to/sagashield'. Il server crea ./workspace (sandbox) e ./sagashield-mcp.db (WAL) nella cwd.
_notes.protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0 su stdio, protocolVersion 2024-11-05. Tool esposti: fs_write, mock_pay, kernel_status, agent_kernel_exec, kernel_replay_session, kernel_export_audit.
